# Soto Growth Systems

> A growth infrastructure company for established, owner-led businesses. Soto Growth Systems diagnoses the 10 Growth Leaks™ in lead capture, follow-up, sales process, CRM discipline, KPI visibility and accountability, then designs and installs the systems that close them. Based in Provo, Utah. Founded by Rich Soto.

## Offers
- [Growth Leak Score™](https://growthleak.sotogrowthsystems.com/): free, self-serve, 10 questions.
- [Professional Growth Leak Assessment™](https://sotogrowthsystems.com/growth-leak-assessment/): starting at $997, credited toward a Growth OS Blueprint™ within 90 days.
- [Growth OS Blueprint™](https://sotogrowthsystems.com/growth-os-blueprint/): self-implementation, starting at $7,500 one-time, 4 to 6 weeks.
- [Growth OS Guided Implementation™](https://sotogrowthsystems.com/growth-os-implementation-draft-v2/): done-with-you, starting at $18,000 setup + $4,500/month, 3-month minimum.
- [Growth OS Managed Implementation™](https://sotogrowthsystems.com/growth-os-managed-implementation/): done-for-you, starting at $35,000 setup + $8,500/month, 6-month minimum.
- [Fractional Growth Operator™](https://sotogrowthsystems.com/fractional-growth-operator/): ongoing operating layer after an implementation, starting at $5,500/month, 6-month minimum.
- [Compare implementation options](https://sotogrowthsystems.com/implementation-options/)
